title: Carrier Money the Insured Awaits, Set Aside from a Past-Due Reconstruction Draw Payment
content:
The part of a past-due Reconstruction draw payment set aside for carrier money the insured is waiting for follows the base overdue rule, which carries nothing on carrier-funded draws while their funds are pending. The carrier figures are those of the linked claim file kept under Insurance Claim Services: its release practice, approvals, write-offs, depreciation release requests, supplement requests, supplement approvals and carrier payments.

**Supplement money pending.** The supplement money pending is the dwelling supplement approvals not yet matched by dwelling supplement payments, or, when there is no such unpaid approval and the dwelling supplement request with the highest supplement number has no supplement approval naming it, that request's requested amount. When an earlier dwelling supplement request still has no supplement approval naming it, the carrier has decided the supplements out of order and the payment is handed to a human representative as not covered by policy.

**Set aside.**

- When the claim arrangement has the carrier release recoverable depreciation only once the work is shown complete and the contract has no substantial completion date yet: the dwelling depreciation withheld on the linked claim file's approvals less the dwelling depreciation released and less the amounts written off as depreciation forfeited, never below zero, plus the supplement money pending.
- When the contract has a substantial completion date and the latest depreciation release request on the claim file, of two on that date the one with the larger requested amount, has no depreciation release payment received on or after its request date: that request's requested amount plus the supplement money pending.
- Otherwise, when supplement money is pending: the supplement money pending.
- Otherwise nothing is set aside.

## Combinations

| Situation on the claim file and contract | Set aside |
|---|---|
| release only on shown completion, no substantial completion date | unreleased depreciation (withheld less released less forfeited, not below zero) plus supplement money pending |
| substantial completion recorded, latest release request with no release payment received on or after its date | that request's amount plus supplement money pending |
| neither of those, supplement money pending | supplement money pending |
| neither of those, no supplement money pending | nothing |

## Worked figures (hypothetical)

- Before completion, release only on shown completion: withheld $6,000.00, released $1,000.00, forfeited $400.00, one unpaid supplement approval balance of $900.00 — set aside $4,600.00 plus $900.00, that is $5,500.00.
- After completion: the latest release request, for $3,100.00, has no release payment since its date, and every supplement is approved and paid — set aside $3,100.00.
